decisions.statement: One line is one json object on one row.
A line has the instant the line was written.
A line has the agent id the writing process ran under.
Lines past the most bytes one file may have roll into a numbered part beside that file.
The first part beside a page is part2.
Each further part takes the next number up.
A part no page names is read by nothing and swept by nothing.
Lines are kept outside the commit.

definition: the console lines a source wrote for one seat on one day
